# GDScript original fixture

`GroupCel.gd` is the complete unchanged 433-byte `src/Classes/Cels/GroupCel.gd`
source from the development corpus's Pixelorama repository. Its SHA-256 is
`5518e6820acda44c8907f12ecbbd7e8c57894ccb4a46a1928469956ca90b864a`.
The complete original MIT license is retained as `LICENSE.txt` (1,120 bytes,
SHA-256 `c41ab6daf72f4cd2da64066dd3951c7199ea4cab8cd1e25aa169719c63df9894`).

The fixture verifies exact written class, constructor and method ownership plus
a string-content negative. Parser source is licensed separately and retains its
own complete upstream tree and provenance. No fixture path affects production.
